Well, a lot of things change, you know. There are new taxes, and the old ones go away, little by little. Your company is going to see it in the bills, I think. And maybe you can get some money back, on some things.

Yes, a few things change. From twenty twenty-seven, your company pays the CBS, the tax that replaces PIS and Cofins. The IBS is the tax that replaces ICMS and ISS, and that change is gradual, until twenty thirty-three. And companies that buy a lot get a credit: the tax in your purchases, like computers and rent, comes off the tax you pay.
